documents.name: authorize_workspace
documents.text:
pub fn authorize_workspace(root: &Path) -> Result<Workspace> { let canonical = root.canonicalize()?; registry.insert(canonical.clone()); Ok(Workspace { root: canonical }) }

pub fn authorized_file(workspace: &Workspace, requested: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf> { let target = requested.canonicalize()?; if !target.starts_with(&workspace.root) { return Err(PathTraversal); } Ok(target) }

documents.name: Workspace authorization
documents.text:
# Workspace authorization
Atlas canonicalizes the selected workspace root and every requested file. Files outside that root, including traversal and symlink escapes, are rejected before reading.

documents.text: fn emit_index_progress(app: &AppHandle, job: &IndexJob) { app.emit(&job.event_id, IndexProgress { processed_files: job.processed, total_files: job.total, chunks: job.chunks }); }

Supported formats
documents.text:
# Supported formats
Atlas indexes TypeScript, TSX, JavaScript, Rust, Python, Markdown, plain text, JSON, YAML, TOML, and PDF files. Binary files and DOCX are not supported.

documents.name: Removing a workspace
documents.text:
# Removing a workspace
Remove from launcher only forgets the recent-workspace entry. It does not delete the local index or workspace conversation history. Data purge is a separate operation.
